attributes.for_each: ${{for k, v in var.vpc_block_public_access_exclusions : k => v if local.create_vpc}}
attributes.subnet_id: ${try(each.value.exclude_subnet, false) ? lookup({private = aws_subnet.private[*].id, public = aws_subnet.public[*].id, database = aws_subnet.database[*].id, redshift = aws_subnet.redshift[*].id, elasticache = aws_subnet.elasticache[*].id, intra = aws_subnet.intra[*].id, outpost = aws_subnet.outpost[*].id}, each.value.subnet_type, null)[each.value.subnet_index] : null}

attributes.tags: ${merge({Name = try(var.public_subnet_names[count.index], format("${var.name}-${var.public_subnet_suffix}-%s", element(var.azs, count.index)))}, var.tags, var.public_subnet_tags, lookup(var.public_subnet_tags_per_az, element(var.azs, count.index), {}))}

${merge({Name = try(var.private_subnet_names[count.index], format("${var.name}-${var.private_subnet_suffix}-%s", element(var.azs, count.index)))}, var.tags, var.private_subnet_tags, lookup(var.private_subnet_tags_per_az, element(var.azs, count.index), {}))}

attributes.count: ${local.create_database_route_table && !var.create_database_internet_gateway_route && var.create_database_nat_gateway_route && var.enable_nat_gateway && var.enable_ipv6 && (length(var.private_subnet_ipv6_prefixes) > 0 || var.private_subnet_ipv6_native) && var.private_subnet_enable_dns64 ? var.single_nat_gateway ? 1 : local.len_database_subnets : 0}

attributes.tags: ${merge({"Name" = format("${var.name}-%s", element(var.azs, var.single_nat_gateway ? 0 : count.index))}, var.tags, var.nat_eip_tags)}
${merge({"Name" = format("${var.name}-%s", element(var.azs, var.single_nat_gateway ? 0 : count.index))}, var.tags, var.nat_gateway_tags)}

attributes.for_each: ${{for k, v in var.security_group_rules : k => v if var.create && var.create_security_group}}
